title: The Flood Returns
subtitle: The tower wants its water back
description: The rigging works, and the first thing it works on is the water,
because the tower has been full since the parish drowned and the
bell will not move through it dry.
This is a fluid task: three thousand millibuckets, three buckets,
handed over at the press. The press takes the water and hands the
empties back -- a submit task, the consenting kind, the same as the
experience tasks everywhere else in the book.
